shared_elements: dense horizontal registers of small repeated carved signs (script-like glyphs)
rectangular inscribed panel framed by borders
relief figural scene above the text register
vertical framing elements/columns at the panel edges
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme of a large framed panel filled with many ruled horizontal lines of small pictorial glyph-signs, with a figural relief zone above the text and vertical framing borders at the sides, executed in the same shallow, regular, schematic relief convention. The main difference is that A is a close view where individual signs and a specific figure/emblem in the upper register are legible, while B shows only the overall panel with its lateral figures indistinct, so no single motif can be matched element for element.
